title: Realistic infected variants
license: Mixamo royalty-free project use; not open source and not licensed as a standalone asset pack
changes: Retained the source mesh geometry, skin weights, and embedded 1024px diffuse and normal textures.
Retargeted Mixamo motion by bone name and world-space bind rotation to each model; scaled hip displacement to each body and removed locomotion X/Z root motion.
Packed self-contained GLBs; shared death and attack variants, held idle pose, and adapted hit reaction.
Uniform runtime fit to existing player scale; original combat balance and collision rules retained.
Repaired clothing opacity and used texture alpha cutouts; authored a brief recoil hit reaction.
build: python scripts/build-infected.py; FBX source clips first converted with Godot FBX2glTF 0.13.1 in .tmp/zombie-source
